THE DESIGN — C+D dark column, in both themes.
One 660px serif reading column on a floating pill nav. Work as a dated log, projects as soft panels (no image slots — nothing can look like a missing screenshot), writing, then a contact card.
Type: Newsreader for reading, JetBrains Mono for every piece of metadata. The whole design is those two faces and one accent.

DARK — the default.
Ground #0a0a0b, panels lifted one step to #101012, hairlines at #1c1c20. Accent mint #7dd3a7 carries the status dot, the italic clause in the intro, and every link hover.
Serif at weight 300 is what keeps this from reading like every other dark dev portfolio.

LIGHT — not an inversion, a counterpart.
Warm paper #fbfaf8 rather than white, panels go pure white and gain a 1px shadow (on dark they were lifted by lightness, which does nothing on paper).
The accent shifts to #2e7d5b — same hue as the mint, dropped in lightness so it passes contrast on paper. A pale mint on white would be unreadable.

Copy in [SQUARE BRACKETS] is still placeholder — that is the next conversation. Project names and stacks are real, from your repo.
Assumption I am building on: the site follows the visitor's system theme on first load, and the toggle remembers their choice after that. Say the word if you would rather it always open dark.
Next: Next.js + Tailwind + TS scaffold on the redesign/v2 branch, built from these two artboards as the source of truth.

ARCHIVE — everything we looked at on the way here. Nothing on this page is being built.
Top row: the three developed takes on the reading column (D1 refined, D2 indexed rail, D3 the ledger).
